Fixed the incorrect `await` on `channel.subscribe()`. Changes:

1. Removed the `await` on line 112 — `channel.subscribe()` doesn't return a Promise
2. Removed the misleading comment about waiting for subscription to complete
3. Changed to call `channel.subscribe()` directly without assigning to a variable

The subscription callback already sets `isSubscribedRef.current` when `status === "SUBSCRIBED"`, so no await is needed. The code now correctly relies on the callback to track subscription status.

No linter errors. The fix is complete.
